==About me==

You call yourselves [[Aes Sedai]] but you have forgotten what [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|being a servant]] means.

In my era, humans and [[Ogier]] lived in a utopian society. Every citizen contributed to the welfare of the people through their own unique skills. Diseases had long since been eradicated. Crime was virtually non-existent. An entire sub-culture [[Da'shain Aiel|dedicated itself to pacifism]]. All people prospered.

I have seen sights that would be considered wonders by today’s standards. My studies began long ago at [[Collam Daan]] where the gorgeous [[Sharom]] floated serenely – a sky-borne pearl that celebrated the art of the [[One Power]]. I once played [[Sha'rah]] with the renowned philosopher [[Elan Morin Tedronai]] in the [[Ansaline Gardens]]. I’ve traveled the [[World Sea]] and visited each of the [[Nine Rods of Dominion|nine dominions]] in turn. I even passed beyond conventional understanding to treat with [[Finn|bizarre trans-dimensional beings]], and gain knowledge to advance our collective society. But foremost of my memories is when I stood in the majestic [[Hall of Servants]] and engaged in debate with the greatest of all Aes Sedai: [[Latra Posae Decume]], [[Demandred|Barid Bel Medar]], and [[Lews Therin Telamon]] – the man we named [[Dragon]].

Even then, being a person born with the ability to [[channel]] was considered rare. But those of us that could do so did not perceive ourselves as superior - as channelers do now. We knew that we were called to be humble stewards of our gift. Some used their powers to advance the causes of engineering, medicine, art, and physics. Others crafted [[ter'angreal]] and [[constructs]] that could serve society. All knew what it meant to place selflessness over selfishness.

We endeavored to be SERVANTS OF ALL.

Gone are those wondrous days; swept away by the [[Breaking of the World]]. Now people have grown savage, plagued by feudalism and warfare - mired in a dark age. Diseases have returned and in some places are a fact of life. Crime flourishes in cities. Aes Sedai survive as a pathetic shadow of their former glory, hobbled by the absence of [[Saidin]]. In some places female channelers are shackled as slaves, treated as human chattel and called [[Damane]]. Throughout the world men who can channel are either killed or [[Severing|severed]] from the source. Truly these are dark times.

Through the use of [[stasis box|ancient technology]] and against my will I was placed in stasis long ago and found myself released into this strange world. I sense the male half of the [[One Power|true source]], but it is hidden behind a [[Taint|veil of filth and corruption]]. The temptation to channel is always strong - yet I resist - lest I be driven mad and bring a new breaking upon the part of the world where I dwell. My field of expertise was in history, academic scholarship, and documentations – for which I was granted a third name - and so I work now to enhance the pages of this wiki and bring a higher standard of enlightenment to the so-called [[Brown Ajah|“historians”]] of this era. Some praise me, but others have ignorantly attacked my efforts while misunderstanding that we labor not for ourselves, but rather the uncountable future generations that will read our words.

I return now to my work. I have heard it said that if one cannot channel, solace might be found in one’s labors. It is a half-truth, for even as I allow myself to be consumed in the arcane lore I cherish, [[Saidin]] is always there, calling me to channel. But I must never do so. In my own small way I will work to do what I can to elevate the enlightenment of mankind in these dark times.

I am a Servant of All
